newsitem.title: UK: Big FX swings to be discussed at G7 - UK officials.
newsitem.headline: Big FX swings to be discussed at G7 - UK officials.

text.p: Finance ministers and central bankers will discuss some of the faster-moving currencies of recent months at this weekend's Group of Seven (G7) meeting, British officials said on Thursday.

"They will be looking at recent developments in currency and financial markets," one official said. "If you were to pick out key movements in currencies over the last two to three months, I'm sure each of those would get an airing."
The dollar has surged against the yen and strengthened against the mark in recent months.
But the British official said such currency discussions were part of the routine process of such meetings and would not be out of the ordinary.
Officials said roughly half the meeting would be taken up with such "surveillance issues" as currencies and developments in the U.S., European and Japanese economies.
European Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) issues are also likely to arise, albeit in an informal way, officials said.

"What normally happens at these meetings is the non-European participants are interested to hear first-hand from the European finance ministers how they see develoments progressing on the European economy and EMU in general," an official said.
